module_library.label: ESP32 DevKit
module_library.summary: Wi-Fi + BLE microcontroller dev board with USB.
warnings: GPIOs are 3.3V logic — do not drive with 5V signals without a level-shifter.

module_library.label: Raspberry Pi Pico
module_library.summary: RP2040 dev board, 3.3V logic, USB, cheap.

module_library.label: LM2596 buck regulator
warnings: Always set output voltage with a multimeter BEFORE connecting your load.

module_library.label: AMS1117 3.3V LDO
module_library.summary: Linear 3.3V regulator, 1A, drops excess as heat.
warnings: Inefficient at high drop — use a buck for >2V drop @ >200mA.

module_library.label: AMS1117 5V LDO
module_library.summary: Linear 5V regulator, 1A, drops excess as heat. Use for clean 5V from 7-15V.
warnings: Heatsink required above ~500mA continuous (LDO dissipates Vin-5V across the load current).
For higher efficiency at >500mA, use a fixed-output 5V buck (e.g. R-78E5.0) instead.

module_library.label: TP4056 Li-ion charger
warnings: Use the protected version (with DW01 chip) — plain TP4056 has NO over-discharge protection and will destroy the cell.
Li-ion cells can vent or ignite if shorted or overcharged.

module_library.label: BME280 env sensor
module_library.summary: Temperature, humidity, pressure — I2C or SPI.
warnings: 3.3V-only — do NOT power from 5V. Check for breakout boards with onboard regulator if you need 5V tolerance.

pins.label: ECHO
pins.notes: Use divider or level-shifter for 3.3V MCU

module_library.label: 1-ch relay 5V

pins.label: IN
pins.notes: Opto input — 3.3V ESP32 GPIO is fine

warnings: If switching mains (>60V AC), isolate the load side completely. Beginners should stick to low-voltage DC.

module_library.label: USB 5V power input
module_library.summary: 5V USB supply (power bank, charger, or host port) via USB connector.
warnings: Use a cable/charger rated for your load current; add a polyfuse for pumps and motors.

module_library.label: 12V DC barrel input
module_library.summary: Bench 12V DC supply via barrel jack (off-board wall adapter).
warnings: Fuse the input and verify polarity before connecting electronics.

module_library.label: IRLZ44N logic-level MOSFET module
module_library.summary: Logic-level N-channel switch, reliable from 3.3V GPIO.
warnings: Add flyback diode across inductive loads (pump/fan/solenoid).

module_library.label: IRF520 MOSFET module
warnings: IRF520 is not a true logic-level FET — switches poorly from 3.3V. Prefer IRLZ44N or AO3400 for 3.3V drive.

module_library.label: L298N motor driver
module_library.summary: Dual H-bridge, up to ~2A/ch. Old, lossy, still cheap.
warnings: Drops ~2V — inefficient at low motor voltages. Consider DRV8833/TB6612 for 3-12V motors.

module_library.label: SG90 servo
warnings: Stall current can exceed 600mA — don't power from MCU 5V pin; use a separate 5V supply.

module_library.label: nRF24L01+ radio
warnings: Power pin is 3.3V-only. Add a 10µF cap across VCC/GND near the module.

module_library.label: INA219 current sensor
module_library.summary: I2C bidirectional current/voltage sensor, ±3.2A, up to 26V bus.
warnings: Default I2C address 0x40; jumpers A0/A1 select 0x41/0x44/0x45.

module_library.label: PCA9685 16-channel PWM/servo driver
module_library.summary: I2C-controlled 16 PWM outputs @ up to 1.6kHz, 12-bit; common for servos.

pins.label: V+
pins.notes: Servo rail; up to 12V absolute max

pins.label: OE
pins.notes: Low: outputs active; high: outputs disabled

warnings: Power servos from V+ on a separate supply, never the logic VCC.

module_library.label: A4988 stepper driver carrier
module_library.summary: Bipolar stepper driver, up to 2A/coil with adequate cooling; 8-35V motor.
warnings: Set the VREF current limit BEFORE connecting the motor.
RST and SLP must be tied together if SLP isn't used (datasheet requirement).

module_library.label: PCF8574 I2C GPIO expander
module_library.summary: Adds 8 quasi-bidirectional GPIO pins over I2C; useful for buttons/LEDs.
warnings: Quasi-bidirectional outputs are weak high-side — use external pull-up for clean reads.

module_library.label: MAX31855 K-type thermocouple amplifier
warnings: Read-only SPI device — DI line not used.
Cold-junction compensation requires the IC sees ambient temperature; don't enclose it.

module_library.label: HX711 24-bit ADC for load cells
module_library.summary: 24-bit ΔΣ ADC with built-in PGA for strain-gauge load cells; up to 80SPS.
warnings: Channel A gain is 128 or 64; channel B is fixed at 32.

module_library.label: 74HC595 8-bit shift register
module_library.summary: Serial-in/parallel-out shift register, daisy-chainable via Q7'.

module_library.label: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC
module_library.summary: 12-bit DAC with internal EEPROM; ratiometric to VDD.

pins.label: VOUT
pins.notes: Analog output 0..VDD; treated as analog_in for safety-rules

module_library.label: DRV8833 dual H-bridge motor driver
module_library.summary: Low-cost dual H-bridge, up to 1.5A/ch (2.5A peak); 2.7-10.8V motor.
warnings: Includes thermal protection; large heat-sink for >1A continuous.

module_library.label: L9110S dual motor driver
warnings: Cheaper but lossy (~1V drop). Prefer DRV8833 for >0.5A or efficiency-sensitive builds.

module_library.label: SCD30 NDIR CO2 / temp / humidity sensor
module_library.summary: True NDIR CO2 (400-10000ppm) with temperature and humidity; I2C or UART.
warnings: Self-heats; place away from MCU and other heat sources for accurate readings.

module_library.label: ENS160 multi-gas air-quality sensor
module_library.summary: TVOC/eCO2/AQI (UBA, BME) over I2C; modern CCS811 replacement.

module_library.label: BTS7960 high-current half-bridge driver
module_library.summary: 43A peak half-bridge (common on robotics); built-in current sense.
warnings: Heatsink mandatory above ~10A continuous.
Two BTS7960 paired form a full H-bridge for bidirectional drive.

module_library.label: MAX98357A I2S Class-D mono amp
module_library.summary: I2S audio input, Class-D 3.2W into 4Ω; no DAC needed.

pins.label: GAIN
pins.notes: Sets amplification via resistor to GND or VIN

warnings: Min 4Ω speaker. SD has internal 100K pulldown — float gives left channel.

module_library.label: BNO055 9-DOF orientation sensor
module_library.summary: Accelerometer + gyro + magnetometer + on-chip sensor fusion; absolute orientation.

pins.label: RST
pins.notes: Pull low then high to reset

warnings: Fusion mode requires calibration — gyro/accel/mag stable for accurate orientation.

module_library.label: MCP23017 16-channel I2C GPIO expander
module_library.summary: 16 GPIO over I2C with per-bank interrupts; up to 25mA per pin.

module_library.label: VL6180X short-range ToF + ambient light
module_library.summary: Time-of-flight ranging up to 10cm + lux measurement; I2C @ fixed 0x29.

pins.label: GPIO
pins.notes: Data-ready signal; may not be readable on 5V MCUs

pins.label: XSHUT
pins.notes: Pull low to shut down; level-shifted for 3-5V

warnings: Fixed I2C address 0x29 — can't change. Use XSHUT for multi-sensor boards.

module_library.label: TB6612FNG dual H-bridge motor driver
module_library.summary: Modern dual H-bridge replacement for L298N; 1.2A/ch continuous, 3.2A peak.

pins.label: STBY
pins.notes: Pull high to enable; low standby

warnings: Much more efficient than L298N — prefer for any new build under 1A continuous.

module_library.label: LC709203F LiPo battery fuel gauge
module_library.summary: I2C single-cell LiPo state-of-charge tracking; with temperature input.

pins.label: INT
pins.notes: Low when below threshold; pulled up to VIN

pins.label: THERM
pins.notes: Connect a 10K thermistor for pack temperature

warnings: Single-cell LiPo only. Disable on-board LED to extend battery life.

module_library.label: Adafruit QT Py ESP32-S3
module_library.summary: Tiny ESP32-S3 dev board (Seeed Xiao footprint); WiFi+BT, 13 GPIO, STEMMA QT.

module_library.label: MAX30102 pulse oximeter / heart-rate
module_library.summary: Integrated red + IR LEDs + photodetector for SpO2 and heart-rate; I2C.

pins.label: RD
pins.notes: Red LED cathode return — typically internal on breakouts

pins.label: IRD
pins.notes: IR LED cathode return — typically internal

warnings: Skin contact and stillness required for SpO2; algorithm matters more than the sensor.

module_library.label: TMC2209 silent stepper driver
module_library.summary: 256-microstep StealthChop driver; quiet vs A4988/DRV8825; UART tuning.

pins.label: VREF
pins.notes: Current limit reference (or set via UART)

warnings: Always power VM before sending STEP pulses. Set VREF for your motor BEFORE running.

module_library.label: SCD41 photoacoustic CO2 sensor
module_library.summary: True NDIR-grade CO2 (400-5000ppm) + temp + RH in a small SMD package; I2C.
warnings: Self-calibrates via periodic ambient exposure; ventilate occasionally for accuracy.

module_library.label: 3-pin mechanical limit switch
module_library.summary: NC/NO endstop with common — typical printer/CNC limit switch.

module_library.label: ESP32-CAM (OV2640)
module_library.summary: ESP32-S with OV2640 camera — 5V in, 3.3V logic, Wi-Fi capture module.
warnings: GPIO0 must be held correctly for flashing. Use separate 5V supply ≥500mA for stable capture.

module_library.label: Arduino Nano V3
module_library.summary: Arduino Nano V3 pinout — 30 GPIO, 5V logic

module_library.label: Arduino Uno R3
module_library.summary: Arduino Uno R3 pinout — ? GPIO, 5V logic

module_library.label: ESP32 DevKit V1
module_library.summary: ESP32 DevKit V1 pinout — 30 GPIO, 3.3V logic

module_library.summary: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B pinout — 40 GPIO, 3.3V logic

pins.notes: Pin 2: Trigger input (active low, below 1/3 VCC)

pins.label: DISCH
pins.notes: Pin 7: Discharge — open collector to GND

module_library.label: 2N2222 NPN BJT
module_library.summary: General-purpose NPN bipolar transistor, TO-92, ~800mA collector current.

pins.label: Emitter
pins.notes: TO-92 pin 1 (flat side facing, leftmost). Typically to GND in NPN low-side switching.

pins.label: Base
pins.notes: Pin 2 (middle). Drive through ~1k resistor from MCU GPIO.

pins.label: Collector
pins.notes: Pin 3 (rightmost). Connect to load; load other end to VCC.

warnings: Pinout differs by manufacturer/case — verify against your specific part's datasheet.
Not a logic-level part; for direct 3.3V/5V drive of large loads prefer a MOSFET.

module_library.label: BC547 NPN BJT
module_library.summary: Common European general-purpose NPN BJT, TO-92, ~100mA collector current.

pins.label: Collector
pins.notes: TO-92 pin 1 (flat side facing, leftmost). NOTE: BC547 pinout is C-B-E, not E-B-C like 2N2222.

warnings: BC547 pinout is C-B-E — opposite of 2N2222. Double-check before populating a board.

module_library.label: 4N35 phototransistor optocoupler
module_library.summary: Logic isolation between two circuits; DIP-6; 5300V isolation.

pins.label: Anode (1)
pins.notes: Input-side LED anode; drive via current-limit resistor from source MCU.

pins.label: Cathode (2)
pins.notes: Input-side LED cathode; tie to input-circuit ground.

pins.label: Emitter (4)
pins.notes: Output-side transistor emitter; tie to output-circuit ground.

pins.label: Collector (5)
pins.notes: Output-side transistor collector; pulled high through external resistor.

pins.label: Base (6)
pins.notes: Usually left floating in basic on/off isolation.

warnings: Provides galvanic isolation — never share grounds between input and output sides.

module_library.label: AT24C32 32Kbit I2C EEPROM
module_library.summary: I2C serial EEPROM, 4096 x 8-bit, DIP-8 / TSSOP-8.

pins.label: A0
pins.notes: Address input bit 0 — sets I2C address (0x50-0x57).

pins.label: WP
pins.notes: Write-protect; tie to VCC to make the chip read-only.

module_library.label: ATmega328P (Arduino Uno/Nano core)
module_library.summary: 8-bit AVR MCU, 32KB flash, 2KB SRAM, 23 GPIO, PDIP-28 or TQFP-32.

pins.label: PB6/XTAL1
pins.notes: Crystal input — or PB6 GPIO if internal RC clock used.

pins.label: AVCC
pins.notes: Analog supply — tie to VCC with bead/filter.

warnings: This is the bare IC — for hands-on use the Arduino Nano/Uno boards (already in the library) instead.
